clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Zargh prepares fresh meat for Gryshka in Orgrimmar. The parcel gives young Horde travelers a reason to learn the wind rider route.

Zargh, an orc butcher and hunter at the Crossroads in the Barrens, prepares fresh cuts for Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. The heat across the savannas can spoil fresh game quickly, so the parcel goes with couriers bound for the Crossroads roost. Wind Rider Master Devrak arranges a wyvern flight to Orgrimmar's Skytower, sparing travelers the long overland journey through Durotar.

Zargh's delivery carries a personal sentiment along with its provisions. When Gryshka receives the meat, she recognizes Zargh's knack for winning a lady's favor with quality game. She is eager to prepare the cuts for the inn's patrons and guests. For newly arrived orc and troll travelers, the delivery offers an introduction to long-distance flight between Kalimdor's Horde settlements.
